fatal_failures: production or authored tests do not compile and run from a clean offline copy
the caller-visible ProcessFail operation is absent
the implementation uses no genuine generated CDM 7.0.0 object at its input or output boundary
the end-leg example emits two gross cash payments or pays the EUR 300,000 in the wrong direction
mini close-out terminates or economically changes another portfolio trade
a start-leg failing seller earns contractual negative-rate interest during the fail window

criteria.description: Net the two selected-trade obligations into one correctly directed close-out payment.
checks: EUR 10,500,000 collateral value less EUR 10,200,000 repurchase price produces exactly one EUR 300,000 payment from buyer to seller.
The result contains no compensating pair of gross flows and does not rely on summing two outputs downstream.
The selected trade is terminated at the effective close-out date and repeated result inspection preserves currency and direction.

criteria.description: Apply a mini close-out only to the identified failed repo.
checks: In a three-repo same-counterparty portfolio, exactly the requested trade changes lifecycle and application state.
The other two CDM TradeState values, economics and histories remain equal to their inputs and are not rebuilt with incidental differences.
The input portfolio and caller-owned collections are not mutated or retained through mutable aliases.
Missing and duplicate trade IDs fail before any partial portfolio update.

criteria.description: Prevent a failing party from earning negative-rate interest without erasing contractual economics outside the fail.
checks: A start-leg failing seller on EUR 10,000,000 at -0.50% ACT/360 has exactly zero seller-perspective payable accrual for every failed day.
No abs, sign inversion or global non-negative-rate rejection turns the contractual negative rate into a charge during normal running.
After resolution, the next normal day produces EUR 138.89 from buyer to seller and does not retroactively accrue or floor the wrong dates.
The state transition makes the fail window and resumption observable and repeatable rather than depending on the current clock.

criteria.description: Use the terminating buyer's replacement offer rather than mid-market valuation.
checks: For 100,000 securities and EUR 90/110, replacement value is EUR 11,000,000 and seller pays buyer EUR 1,000,000 net.
For the same-mid EUR 98/102 quote, the payment is EUR 200,000; the two outputs are observably different.
Bid and offer are validated as coherent exact decimals and no default-to-mid path survives.

criteria.description: Represent lifecycle and cash facts coherently without pretending CDM owns fail policy.
checks: The portfolio boundary contains genuine CDM TradeState objects and the mini-close-out result records a version-correct terminated ClosedState or comparably defensible generated lifecycle object.
Any emitted CDM Money or transfer has coherent currency, amount, payer/receiver direction and its own plus populated-child generated conditions executed where applicable.
Fail identity, dates, selected valuation side, accrual bucket and scope policy remain explicit application facts rather than invented generated fields.
DESIGN.md accurately separates generated model semantics from the supplied mini-close-out convention.

criteria.description: Deliver deterministic exact code with focused defenses against plausible failures.
checks: Inputs and actions validate before zero/no-payment shortcuts; currencies, dates, quotes, basis, identities and closed-state preconditions fail visibly.
The monetary path uses BigDecimal without double/float and rounds once at the supported currency scale.
Required tests plus close negative controls pass from a clean offline copy without current-clock, default-zone or mutable-static state.
